shared_or_similar_visual_information: Circular markers at boundaries of marked spans or plotted branches. Compare the lower marker at x = 1 in the left image with the marker at 1 on the number line in the right image.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The parabolic branch supplies the included point at x = 1. Right image: The interval includes the lower boundary 1.
